android-capi-http-client.description: Allow Android C API consumers to provide custom HTTP send/cancel callbacks.

android-curl-mbedtls.description: Enable Android native libcurl HTTP with mbedTLS. Can be combined with android-curl-openssl.

android-curl-openssl.description: Enable Android native libcurl HTTP with OpenSSL. Can be combined with android-curl-mbedtls.

curl-mbedtls.description: Add mbedTLS to the Linux libcurl HTTP client alongside its required OpenSSL backend.

curl-openssl.description: Compatibility feature for Linux OpenSSL, which is always included in core.

device-id.description: Collect a native device ID (default). Omit with default-features=false to provide your own DeviceInfo.Id.

no-exceptions.description: Disable exceptions in SDK-owned targets without changing consumer or dependency flags.

no-logging.description: Compile out internal diagnostics without disabling telemetry collection.

system-sqlite.description: Compatibility feature for external SQLite, which is always included in core.

wininet.description: Use Windows WinInet instead of the default WinHTTP transport.
